Publish a Deck B badgerbreath Nov 20, 2026 Doesn’t always work but very fun when does~ 
Free retreat with plaza, get Meowstic into the active to ensure confusion off its ability, then either hit for 40 chip or retreat into Malamar for early 100 damage with only one energy. Otherwise inkay can confuse and potentially stall before getting Meow online for consistent confuse. 
Since energy costs are so low, power M Mewtwo X in the meantime. Plaza also ensures Mewtwo is doing 140. 
Consistency cards like Sightseer and May thrown in as well. (edited) Published Deck CatSquid Confusion Malamar / Mega Mewtwo X ex View all 20 Cards → Like 0 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck G GymLeader Nov 19, 2026 This is probably the most consistent mewtwo deck that you will find, yes its based on the skarmory deck but its actually stronger.
1. You benefit from almost every stadium
2.minior can utilize your fighting support 
3.mewtwo X is guaranteed setup in 1 turn with mantyke Published Deck MewTwo X Mega Mewtwo X ex / Minior View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck N nikin.tcg Nov 18, 2026 **Dual Fusion Event - Restricted Cards Format**

A deck to use in the newest event, featuring one Pidgeot line for "gust" and one Pawmot line for Pikachu's mana acceleration.

I was surprised to see how it dominates easily every other playable deck in this restricted format.

10/10. Worth trying out. Published Deck Pika Pigeot - DF Pikachu ex / Pidgeot View all 20 Cards → Like 0 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck K Kycse Nov 17, 2026 This mish-mash of cards works surprisingly well. There is a lot of 1-of cards here that would lead u to believe its inconsistent, but most things are fairly similar (with specific strengths) that in a bind can do another cards job well enough. This gives you the freedom to play things in different ways beased on the situation and the context of your hand.

Plenty of card draw, Heal/Defense, and a natural resistance to status (thru switch+retreat) this versatile deck handles well in this meta. Published Deck Buck Bumble Revavroom / Mega Scizor ex View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck M marcenero2 Nov 17, 2026 Updated Arceus Crobat Deck
- Can cycle through the deck insanely quick.
- Super consistent even with Arceus being in the active first turn.
- Doesn't care for sleepscam.
- Arceus pretty tanky with eviolite, can absorb damage until you draw your ilima. Published Deck Updated ArcBat Deck Arceus ex / Crobat View all 20 Cards → Like 0 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck S shiny_jemmz Nov 12, 2026 A very slight change on the deck Maddy featured a few days ago. I believe all I did was take his advice and add a second Sabrina. The results are pretty wild as I've won 8 in a row, beat many Zards. Not sure yet if Sableye or Absol are better partners but I think the extra damage of Sableye makes more sense late game (doesn't make it far enough to know)

Serena, poke comm, x speed, poke balls all make this surprisingly consistent to get eevee into active. Repel/Sabrina keep umbreon hitting hard. Published Deck Moonlit Jewel Umbreon / Mega Sableye ex View all 20 Cards → Like 0 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck K Kycse Nov 10, 2026 It just works.

Dont sleep on Leaf. I tend to let the Lycanroc EX go down and if they attempt to setup a surprise leaf puts them in a really tough spot. You draw through your deck very quickly and Mega Lucario with even only 2 Energy hits hard Published Deck Roc'em Sock'em Lycanroc ex / Mega Lucario ex View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck F frozenlgnd Nov 8, 2026 Published Deck Pawmot Pikachu Pikachu ex / Pawmot View all 20 Cards → Like 0 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck T TokyoYellow Nov 8, 2026 How the Deck Functions:

This aggressive Lightning-type deck aims to power up Pikachu ex quickly.

Pichu supports the early game, while Electric Generator accelerates energy.

Pikachu ex leads the offense, targeting quick knockouts against Basic Pokémon. Zeraora provides additional attacking options, while Oricorio offers defensive coverage against opposing Pokémon ex.

Trainer cards provide draw power, healing, mobility, and disruption. Blastoise can generate energy, then Vaporeon can give the energy to Mega Blastoise and finish the game.

Or let Blastoise charge himself attack second then finish with Mega Blastoise.

Some games can also be won just with turn 2 Blastoise Published Deck Double Blastoise Mega Blastoise ex / Vaporeon View all 20 Cards → Like 2 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck I Infamous_D Nov 6, 2026 A fun deck that I did the emblem event with. I wouldn't call this deck good, but it's fun when it works and for whatever reason causes a lot of salty scoops. Can definitely be refined more to be more consistent but it gets the job done! Published Deck BZZZzzzt! Rotom ex / Ribombee View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck L LynxDDragon Nov 6, 2026 Eviolite Makes Dhelmise Tanky. But you never want to Lead with it, so there's just one Copy. BE Eevee counters Umbreon by Evolving into Leafeon turn 1.

Leafeon is your Ramp and Early Attacker, it'll help you set up Dhelmise.

With Eviolite and 1-2 Venusaurs healing it for 30-60 Damage, Dhelmise becomes really hard to get rid of. Not to mention the most important tech in this deck:

You can Blue Provoke your opponent's Megas/EXs and LOCK them into the Active

Just concede if you lead Dhelmise Published Deck Anchor Beam Leafeon ex / Venusaur View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck J jacksonahc Nov 4, 2026 Only use steel energy. Start with 1 dialga in play, use metallic turbo to power the other dialga on the bench, keep the dialgas alive with shaymin’s ability off the bench and potions. Keep shaymin alive with giant cape and equip at least 1 dialga with the rocky helmet. First Dialga powers the rest of the team while tanking. Second dialga is the win condition. Published Deck Dialgarceus Mewmin Dialga ex / Arceus ex View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck K Kycse Nov 4, 2026 Not sure what to think of this thing but its not bad. You basically suvive until you can turbo your Mega Scizor with Mantyke and use Ribombee for heals (not that good but can pop off sometimes) Loses hard to Zard Y

I took out Professors Research and it's working way better than it should? Won most of my games except for one where my last card was Scyther. I beat the one zard deck i played but it was the Fuecoco variant (less good imo) Published Deck Buck Bumble Revavroom / Mega Scizor ex View all 20 Cards → Like 1 · Sign in Share · Sign in Open Deck L LynxDDragon Nov 4, 2026 Realized the Counter to Umbreon is it's pre-evolution, Boosted Evolution Eevee. It can evolve into Flareon before Umbreon can attack. Otherwise use SOE Eevee

Once you have 2 Energies on Flareon, it can help do 100 damage per turn: Invest Zone Energy into Aura Zard (30 damage), Attack with Flareon (40 Damage), then Give the additional energy to Zard again (30 Damage).
